entries.german: Belehnung des Albrecht von Rosenberg[-Boxberg] mit dem Kirchensatz und etlichen Zinsen, Gülten und Gütern zu Oberbalbach durch Graf Ludwig Kasimir von Hohenlohe[-Neuenstein], 1563 Sept. 24 [Regest].
entries.english: Enfeoffment of Albrecht von Rosenberg[-Boxberg] with the patronage right and various rents, revenues, and properties in Oberbalbach by Count Ludwig Kasimir von Hohenlohe[-Neuenstein], September 24, 1563 [regesta].

facts.content: received the church patronage and various rents, annuities and properties at Oberbalbach as a fief from Count Ludwig Kasimir of Hohenlohe.
